0x0ad9_SKHX_exit.caveat: Acquisition cost legs are not fully public, so this is not a complete FIFO reconstruction.

critical_findings: No reviewed wallet supplies a complete uniform public trade ledger across the entire requested history.
Exact average entry and exit prices are unavailable for many closed cycles and are never imputed.
0x95da demonstrates closed-win-rate bias: 100% recent closed wins coexists with about -$222.2K open unrealized PnL.
0x0ad9 selected SKHX history shows adding into weakness and recovery/break-even style exit after about -$2.59M floating loss; this risk behavior is not transferable to Arz.
Frank, Cupsey, Unipcs and TheSolstice show material winner concentration in reviewed provider windows.
Cupsey has a severe methodology conflict: uwuu reports 44d average hold/84.1% win while KOL Explorer position cycles show 17s median/40.4% win.
Capital withdrawals must be separated from trading drawdown, especially for 0x9871 and 0x0ad9.
A follower must be evaluated at delayed follower quotes and bounded sizing; leader fills, leverage and whale notionals are not reproducible assumptions.
missing_for_full_reconstruction: Complete finalized fill/swap event history for every wallet and requested time window
Deterministic cost basis for all deposits/transfers and acquired tokens
Complete fees/funding for every Hyperliquid cycle
Exact entry/exit pairings for provider rows that are only aggregates
Point-in-time follower quotes for latency/slippage simulation
Unified realized/unrealized semantics across Solana providers
interpretation: This package is research evidence and hypothesis generation only. It does not approve any wallet for blind copy trading or modify Arz live-disabled boundaries.
